question.text: A circular disc has radius $R_{1}$ and thickness $T_{1}$. Another circular disc made of the same material has radius $R_{2}$ and thickness $T_{2}$. If the moment of inertia of both discs are same and $\frac{R_{1}}{R_{2}}=2$ then $\frac{T_{1}}{T_{2}}=\frac{1}{\alpha}$. The value of $\alpha$ is $\_\_\_\_$.
